item.title: - Rotation Matrix in Euclidean Space Using Spin Operator Sz
item.description: Introduction # This document explores how to represent rotation matrices in Euclidean space using the spin operator $S_z$ along the rotation axis $n_z$. Angular Momentum Operator $L_z$ # The angular momentum operator $L_z$ can be represented as: $$L_z = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & -i & 0 \\ i & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$$ This operator has eigenvalues $+1$, $0$, and $-1$ with corresponding eigenvectors: $$|+1\rangle = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(1, i, 0)$$ $$|0\rangle = (0, 0, 1)$$ $$|-1\rangle = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(1, -i, 0)$$
